purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
summary: Eritrea's national cadastral custodian and official cadastre reporting are evidenced, but no Massawa-local public parcel viewer/API or safe parcel geometry response was found. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Tigrinya/Arabic discovery queries are recorded in city-1200-massawa.json. Results identified the Ministry of Land, Water and Environment/Cadastral Office and official Massawa regional context, but no Massawa parcel service.
requestOutcomes: ArcGIS Online catalog search returned HTTP 200 with zero matching items. A public ERI_SheEb_1997 ArcGIS cached map loaded HTTP 200 but is non-cadastral and outside Massawa. The official ministry article loaded HTTP 200 and documents Keren cadastre operations only. Two government-domain candidates failed DNS resolution. No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe-field request or TLS-disable action was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [15.614546304822, 39.4488135378123] was preserved; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No Massawa city boundary or complete city coverage was established for an open geometry service.
No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, source schema or CRS was retrieved or retained.
National cadastral-office documentation and Keren-specific cadastre reporting are not treated as proof of a Massawa-local registry adapter.
A zero catalog result, DNS failure or non-cadastral map extent is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. A future retained sample must use exactly one stable native identity in GeoJSON properties and document its source field here.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: The national cadastral custodian is evidenced, but Massawa-local registry status, public anonymous geometry access, city scope, schema, CRS and stable native parcel IDs remain unknown.
